text: Immunology is a discipline that studies the structure, function, immune response mechanisms of the body's immune system, as well as the patterns of occurrence of related diseases. Its core lies in revealing the scientific principles of "how the body recognizes and eliminates foreign substances (such as bacteria and viruses), while avoiding attacking its own tissues". It is not only a fundamental discipline in life sciences but also a key support in the medical field. It is closely related to the prevention and control of infectious diseases, the treatment of tumors, and the research of autoimmune diseases, and is hailed as the "shield science for safeguarding health".
